notes: Front free wheel is +X,+Y; rear free wheel is -X,-Y. Y and Z are inherited from the opposite servo shafts.
One bearing per passive wheel is a compact prototype choice, not a validated moment-load design.
Servo geometry and mounting holes remain assumed. Bearing envelope and axle dimensions are sourced; ring internals and cap screws are representative.
Powered wheels are context envelopes only; no horn interface or powered-wheel STL is supplied here.
Printed spacers have 0.4 mm radial walls. Inspect slicer paths and actual spin clearance; metal 3 mm ID / 4 mm OD spacers are an alternative.
